company_summary: Distinct Possibility Studios is developing Reaper Actual, an AAA-quality, open-world persistent shooter with PvPvE warfare and resource gathering. Built on Tezos-based Etherlink Layer 2, the game aims to blend immersive gameplay with blockchain technology for player-owned bases and other features.

BitMine is a vertically integrated company in the Bitcoin and Ethereum network, offering immersion-cooled mining and institutional-grade treasury services. They boost mining efficiency by submerging rigs in dielectric fluid, providing advanced solutions for crypto asset management.

SuperGaming is an India-based mobile gaming studio known for developing popular titles like MaskGun and Indus - Battle Royale. They provide a proprietary hyperscale real-time multiplayer and Web3 gaming infrastructure, enabling various games across devices for a global audience.

Overtake operates a peer-to-peer marketplace on the Sui blockchain, facilitating secure and decentralized trading of gaming digital assets like items, currencies, and collectibles. It aims to provide true player ownership and frictionless product experiences for everyday gamers, leveraging smart contract escrow and AI-powered search to solve the problem of insecure and centralized asset trading.

Pumpcade is a Solana-based platform that enables instant creation and trading of meme coins, streamlining token deployment for rapid asset launch and listing. It also powers a decentralized, livestream-integrated prediction market platform, built around a community-driven model for participation and discovery.

Pixie Chess is a Web3 chess game that combines classic chess with trading-card-style mechanics and crypto-native incentives. It aims to provide a novel gaming experience and financial experiment for players interested in chess, trading card games, and crypto.

RealGo is a Web3 augmented reality mobile game that transforms real-world locations into interactive gaming experiences. It allows players to explore landmarks, collect meme-inspired characters, and engage in battles within a social finance economy.

Verse8 is a Web3 platform that redefines digital interaction through immersive, tokenized experiences, combining social networking, gamification, and blockchain ownership. It enables users to create, engage, and monetize content in decentralized environments.

Watch.fun is an on-chain platform that blends luxury watch collecting with real-time social entertainment. It gamifies attention by rewarding users for engaging with content and experiences, allowing them to earn tokens and incentives.
investors: Crypto.com Capital; Solana Ventures; Spartan Capital; Big Brain Holdings; Griffin Gaming Partners; Animoca Brands; Morningstar Ventures; OrangeDAO

company_summary: Boys Club is a Web3 platform dedicated to making crypto and internet-native culture accessible, particularly for women and underrepresented groups. They achieve this through educational programs, events, and content that fosters community and on-chain experimentation.

LootGO is a Web3 meme-rewards platform that gamifies everyday life into a treasure hunt for crypto rewards. It allows users to earn memecoins by walking, reaching step goals, or visiting specific locations to collect and open loot boxes, solving the problem of engaging users with Web3 in a fun and accessible way.

Noice is a social-value tokenization protocol on the Base chain, enabling users to monetize social interactions on platforms like Farcaster. It facilitates micro-payments for engagement, transforming online activity into tangible value for creators.

categories: Meme; Gaming; NFT; P2E; Solana Ecosystem
company_summary: CapyBobo is a Solana-based meme and gaming ecosystem that blends entertainment, community engagement, and decentralized finance. It integrates meme culture with play-to-earn gaming and NFT experiences, offering holders access to exclusive events and minigames.

Beezie is a social marketplace for collectors and resellers, focusing on high-value graded collectibles like trading cards, sneakers, and video games. It allows users to pull items via "Claw" machines, buy/sell in a marketplace, or redeem physical items, integrating blockchain technology to turn physical inventory into onchain assets.

Gigaverse is a browser-based, on-chain RPG designed for crypto-native users, featuring fast-paced gameplay, in-game marketplaces, and blockchain-native mechanics. The company aims to engage communities through risk-reward crafting and NFT-backed accounts, built on an Ethereum Layer 2 solution.

Crystalfall is a free-to-play, steampunk hack-and-slash action RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players choose from hybrid animal-hero classes and explore randomized dungeons, battling automatons and muta.

Vayla is a Web3 music fan platform connecting artists, fans, and digital communities through blockchain-powered engagement. It enables creator discovery, community voting, fan-driven funding, digital ownership, and reward mechanisms within a decentralized fandom economy.

categories: Education; Entertainment/Travel; Gaming; P2E; Social Network
company_summary: Take My Muffin (TMM) is an interactive Web3 quiz platform that educates users about blockchain, crypto, and decentralized technologies. It gamifies learning by rewarding participants for correct answers and engagement, blending education with entertainment.

Help.fun is a crypto-native fundraising platform designed for nonprofits and startups to raise capital on-chain with integrity. It features anti-bot mechanics for fair token launches and extends beyond charitable causes to address broader on-chain fundraising issues.

CiDi Games is a Web3 gaming platform focused on mobile-first blockchain games with real digital ownership. It allows players to collect, trade, and upgrade on-chain assets while engaging in skill-based gameplay and competitive events.

MoonClash is a Web3 tower defense strategy game developed by PlayFirst, featuring real-time combat and play-to-earn (P2E) mechanics. It blends strategic defense with NFT-based digital ownership, allowing players to earn, trade, and upgrade in-game assets within an evolving lunar metaverse.

Dare Market is a platform where users can create, fund, and participate in dares using cash or cryptocurrency. It aims to transform online challenges into engaging, viral content that rewards participants.
